title: Keith house's parapet band measured too deep against two photographs
items: 1808 Prairie (1904): measured against the view from Glessner's front door and Florian's 1948 photograph, the stone band between the parapet's pierced lattice and the carved band below it is drawn about 0.1-0.17 m too deep.

The difference was put down to how one camera was fitted. It is not the camera: it reads the same no matter how that camera is fitted, so it is the building, and correcting it is the next step for this house.
